notice: FICTIONAL: every snippet was written for this corpus in common job-posting wording. No company, posting or person is real.
labels: pay is true when the snippet states a figure or range for the person's own pay: salary, wage, hourly or day rate, on-target earnings or a stipend paid as pay. It is false for vague pay ('competitive'), company money (funding, revenue, volumes), perks and allowances (including perk stipends), bonuses, commission or equity on their own, product prices and deal sizes, and numbers that are not money. The id prefix names the wording family.

families.pm: pay next to other money or in a longer snippet
